# Social preview

Upload `social-preview.png` through **Repository → Settings → Social preview → Upload image**.
Adding this file to `.github/` does not activate the preview.

The PNG is 1280 × 640 pixels and under 1 MB. `social-preview.svg` is the editable
source. It uses the Ethos Link website’s Manrope and DM Sans fonts and its
navy, teal, paper and mint palette. Install those fonts before editing or
rendering the SVG. Preserve the 2:1 composition and keep labels readable.

Use the same image on the canonical project page:
https://www.ethos-link.com/opensource/ruby-llm-codex
